description: Vietnam - Wind Measurement Data_GIZ is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Resource assessments, Wind", published or maintained by GIZ. PECC3 was commissioned by GIZ to conduct assessment of long term wind resource at 10 sites under the Program “Wind Measurement for Developing Wind Power Plan and Wind Power Project. The measurement campaign was carried in the time frame 2012-2014. This dataset provides access to the measurement data and to the final reports. Coverage: Vietnam. It has 4 files in CSV, ZIP. The portal files it under Resource assessments, Wind. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
